Description

LogiGolf is a relaxing golf puzzle game where you place walls to guide the ball. Journey between islands to uncover new challenges and surprising discoveries.

History

LogiGolf development started in 2024 by a tiny italian indipendent game development studio, Moon Tile. The game demo was published on Steam in May 2026.

Features

  • Big ocean full of islands to explore
  • A lot of surpring golf puzzle mechanics to discover
  • Relaxing point and click moment in between puzzles
